decisions.reason: Razor-sharp is the natural English for 날카롭게 벼린 without changing the action.
Drops the extra comma and uses the natural butchering collocation cut the hides from, matching 도려낸.
Kindness in his voice matches 호의 어린 목소리 better than attributing kindly to the voice itself.
What am I, a teenager? is the natural self-rebuke for 사춘기도 아니고; BASE's puberty line reads translated.
SOL drops 도 (even), 슬쩍 (sidled), and the mouth-open beat 입을 벌렸다.
SOL adds all day, which 밥 먹고 이것만 했냐 does not say.
Full-blown professional is the more spoken English for 완전 전문가.
Quick with my hands is the English idiom for 손이 빠른.
SOL drops 알바 (part-time) from 공장 알바.
Kept it up is the natural English for 계속했고요 without changing the claim.
Preserves 그냥 (just) and the clipped 투잡 fragment SOL turns into a full sentence.
정확히 어떤? asks what kind, not the past what did you do.
BASE's rest time is stiff; SOL drops 그냥, changes 쪼개서 to carved out, and shifts habitual present to past.
decisions.replacement: “I just split the breaks after combat to do the work.”

decisions.reason: 받습니까 is present-habitual; SOL's did you is the wrong tense.
Comma before too is the same line; no real gain.
계속했는데요 is I've kept at it; SOL's The whole time duplicates 처음부터 지금까지 쭉.
혀를 내둘렀다 is astonishment; SOL invents a head-shake.
독한 놈 is hardcore, not relentless, which belongs to later 악착같이.
SOL adds using it and weakens 악착같이 from relentlessly to as hard as.
그런 말을 했어? is Did you say that?; SOL adds told him.
열심히 해 is keep working hard; Keep it up drops the diligence.
SOL adds seriously, which 아니, 뭔데? does not have.
In sync preserves 손발을 맞춰서; SOL's worked together is generic.
BASE adds I practiced and reverses Korean order; SOL adds people, routines, and myself.
decisions.replacement: Not the dance-like moves practiced in the city park at dawn, but real martial arts. I’d seen them with my own eyes and even learned them.

decisions.reason: 시도해 보는 거다 is a decision to try; SOL's could at least weakens it to a possibility.
Just as…— sets up the interruption of 그 순간이었다 more cleanly than That was the moment.
Snapped me back to my senses is the English for 정신이 확 든다; BASE leaves back incomplete.
The thought already lives in the next BASE paragraph; inserting it here would split and flatten the -다니 rebuke.
한눈을 팔다니 is an exclamatory fragment; SOL flattens it to past-tense narration.
SOL changes 예의 to only fair and 신념 to principle.
Coming! is the snappier English shout for urgent 갑니다.
Ran like the wind is the idiom for 바람처럼 달려가; raced over doubles the speed verb.
얼쩡거렸다 is loitered, not hovered; BASE's rest period is stiffer than break.
decisions.replacement: Team Leader Choi and Im Kkeokjeong loitered nearby throughout the break, as if they weren’t tired at all.

decisions.reason: Context makes Choi and Im the annoyance; They’re fits the loitering beat better than impersonal It’s.
Practically a master is the tighter collocation with the repeated 달인.
Matches the terse 그다음 휴식 때도; SOL adds Then again.
Need to get back to work is the natural brush-off for 저 작업 좀.
찢어진 is torn open; ruptured medicalizes the joke.
Cast a silence spell is the English verb for 마법 걸어; put a spell is calqued.
Colon marks the apposition 방법은 하나밖에 없다 / 끝내는 것 more cleanly than a period.
SOL drops 일어섰다 (stood up); BASE's generous is flatter than 아낌없이 주는.
decisions.replacement: I stood up with the bag on my back, heavier than before. Hobgoblins were the monsters that kept on giving. Poison-resistant hides, a few usable weapons—and they even dropped two E-grade Magic Gems.

decisions.reason: 되겠는데 is should, not could; SOL's haul is not in 이거.
decisions.replacement: *The hides are in good condition, and there are two Magic Gems. This should be worth a decent amount.*

decisions.reason: Turn a profit is the idiomatic English for 남는 장사.
존대 is polite speech, which SOL gets; saint overstates 인격자, which BASE keeps.
decisions.replacement: Team Leader Choi was a fairly generous employer. He was a C-rank Hunter way out of my league, yet he always spoke politely to me. His personality was a little unusual, but in this line of work, that made him a decent human being.

decisions.reason: Korean is a continuing fragment 그리고 …고; adding he’s is unnecessary.
안정적이고 빠른 속도 is a steady, rapid pace, not without any trouble.
Last stretch and final part are the same 마지막; no gain.
마력장 is mana field in the Hunter system; magic field is the wrong term, and back is added.
나가서 is go out; grab drops leaving the Gate, and SOL drops 그리고.
Even planning captures 까지 on the sushi line more fluently than on top of that.
중간중간 is in between; between fights adds a specifier the line does not have.
Preserves the 소원이 없겠다 wish and 꿀 as sweet; SOL recasts the grammar and uses cushy.
BASE's dirt mistranslates 먼지; SOL's exploded and showering the ground add force and a landing place.
decisions.replacement: The gate blew apart, and powdered stone and dust poured down. I followed the others into the Boss Zone.

decisions.reason: 놈이 있었다 is It was there; It stood adds posture.
그려진 is marked/drawn on, not covered with.
SOL intensifies 큰 소리 to deafening and adds completely to 아랑곳하지 않고.
녀석들 is the ones, not the glossary word monsters.
이게 도대체 무슨 is What the hell is this, not going on.
처음 겪는 상황 is a situation, not an unprecedented sight.
정체를 알 수 없는 is unknown, not mysterious.
마법의 발현이다 is magic taking form, not the spell activated.
Cast is the natural English verb once the line has already established a spell.
Behind us! matches the clipped shout 뒤다! without padding It’s.
시계를 거꾸로 돌린 것처럼 is the clock image; time had been reversed genericizes it.
Korean has the rubble actively stacking 이중, 삼중 walls; SOL changes floor to ground and bound to wound.
decisions.replacement: The rubble on the floor stacked itself into double and triple walls, and vines from the cave walls bound them tight.

decisions.reason: 썼는지 is probably, not the stronger must have.
Keeps 스킬까지 (even) from BASE and the 커녕 payoff All he’d managed from SOL.
decisions.replacement: Im Kkeokjeong dropped the tower shield, his face blank with disbelief. An E-rank Hunter had even used a Skill and still hadn’t broken through. All he’d managed to do was wreck his shield.

decisions.reason: SOL adds powerful enough to make it, which the 이 정도 마법을 구사하는 line does not argue.
Who could face it is the plainer English for 상대할 사람; capable of is stiffer.
SOL adds we as agent and blocked; 통로가 뚫리지 않을 is the passage wouldn't break.
미끄러진다 is slid, not shot, and 검이 뽑혀 나왔다 makes the sword the subject.
Same 전력을 다한 공격 noun phrase; word-order swap is not an improvement.
BASE drops 그러나 and 비릿하게; SOL keeps both but adds an unsupported him.
decisions.replacement: But the old Hobgoblin gave a nasty grin.

decisions.reason: 흩어진다 is dispersed, not crumbled, and SOL drops 완전히 from 완전히 뽑혀 나온.
튕겨 나온 is bounced back, which SOL's went flying loses; BASE's twisted face is calqued.
decisions.replacement: Team Leader Choi bounced back fast. His face contorted as he said,

decisions.reason: 유형화된 기운 is energy given form; tangible mass adds mass the line does not have.
SOL drops 괴물 (monster), 든 (holding), and weakens 터질 것 같은 근육 to bulging.
넋 나간 목소리로 is a dazed voice; SOL drops voice.
놈들의 정체 is what they were; the monsters over-specifies.
Spoken ID matches the bare species label 홉 고블린 대전사; adding A is unnecessary.
One but-sentence matches 지만 and 뒤에 붙은 말에 비하면 more smoothly than two clipped sentences.
The thought echoes the term as labeled; A is extra.
BASE tautologically repeats rare; SOL replaces 희귀 몬스터 with special creature and adds should.
decisions.replacement: Rare Monsters were uncommon monsters that appeared in a given Gate only at a low rate. And that Great Warrior was C-rank—something neither I nor the other team members would ever have run into in our lives.

decisions.reason: Not anymore matches clipped 이젠 아니지만; that was no longer true is heavier.
Same species-label announcement as the Great Warrior line; A is extra.
Grim expression is the natural English for 굳은 얼굴; stiff face is calqued.
그 대신 is In exchange, the tradeoff setup; But… erases it.
묶어 놔야 is hold down/pin, not hold off.
누가? is Who?; Who does? over-completes the beat.
BASE's sent … dropping is awkward; SOL's crashing overstates 뚝 떨어졌다.
decisions.replacement: The Great Warrior’s roar sent a stalactite falling from the cave ceiling.

decisions.reason: 돌아섰다 is turned; away adds a direction the face-visible beat does not require.
